description: Defines the SharedFdChannel class which inherits from Channel, providing methods for sending and receiving messages over shared file descriptors in the 'cuttlefish' transport namespace.

classes.name: SharedFdChannel
classes.description: A class representing a communication channel using shared file descriptors, capable of sending and receiving messages.

methods.name: SharedFdChannel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the channel with input and output shared file descriptors.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message through the channel.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message through the channel.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives a message from the channel.

methods.name: WaitForMessage
methods.description: Waits for a message to arrive on the channel.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Internal method to send a message, with an option to specify if it is a response.
